mapper.insert: INSERT INTO events (workspace_id, created_by, title, description, color, start_datetime, end_datetime) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{createdBy}, #{title}, #{description}, #{color}, #{startDatetime}, #{endDatetime})
mapper.update: UPDATE events SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, color = #{color}, start_datetime = #{startDatetime}, end_datetime = #{endDatetime} WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
mapper.select: SELECT event_id, title, start_datetime, end_datetime FROM events WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND LOWER(title) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') ORDER BY event_id
SELECT sprint_id FROM sprints WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'PLANNING') ORDER BY status = 'ACTIVE' DESC, start_date, sprint_id LIMIT 1

SELECT event_id, workspace_id, title, description, color, start_datetime, end_datetime FROM events WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND start_datetime BETWEEN #{startDatetime} AND #{endDatetime} ORDER BY start_datetime, event_id
